definitions.explanation: A rectangular block of fired clay used in building construction.

examples.japanese: レンガ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧レンガ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Red brick buildings are lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧レンガ⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse is popular as a tourist spot.

notes:
レンガ refers to rectangular blocks of fired clay or similar material used in construction. In Japan, brick is primarily associated with Western-style architecture and is less common in traditional Japanese building.

WRITING: Also written in kanji as ⟦{煉瓦|れんが}→煉瓦：04093_renga⟧, but the katakana form レンガ is more common in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レンガ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: to lay/stack bricks
- レンガ{造|づく}り: brick construction
- レンガ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧: brick wall
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧レンガ: red brick

COUNTER: ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ (for individual bricks).
